title: S-norisampler (orac)
excerpt: This is a conversion of the C&G nori sampler patch to a module for Orac....
content:
This is a conversion of the C&G nori sampler patch to a module for Orac.

(which you must have installed, see https://patchstorage.com/orac)

This patch was produced as a demonstration of how to convert existing patches to modules, you can see this

Installing 
--------------

place zop file into the same directory as Orac (not in the orac directory, not in the modules directory!).
e.g. if you installed Orac into /usbdrive/Patches,
then place the S-norisampler.zop into /usbdrive/Patches

then when you place the usb drive back into the organelle.
you will see the option ‘Install S-norisampler’ 
click it and your done.

(if you dont see it, then you have put it in the wrong place)
